summary: Implemented E3052, E3053 and E3054 as three new keyword-based rules in src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs/: ServiceNetworkConfiguration.py, TaskDefinitionAwsVpc.py and ServiceFargate.py. Added unit tests test_service_network_configuration.py, test_task_definition_aws_vpc.py and test_service_fargate.py under test/unit/rules/resources/ecs/. All 98 ECS and rule-collection tests pass when run with PYTHONPATH pointing at this tree's src. Caveat: the shared venv's editable cfnlint install points at a base/ checkout, so a plain run there would not exercise these files. black and ruff were not available, so formatting was checked by hand against the 88-column limit. Nothing was committed, and no existing rule, helper, registry, schema, or docs file was changed.
